candidate.name: m4rel
candidate.semantics_note: the absolute/exclusive vocabulary in fire_condition is illustrative, NOT the detector: detection is semantic per fire_condition (out-of-diff referent + unsubstantiated by the change + documentation is the stated purpose); keyword-only matching is insufficient and non-conformant
candidate.fire_condition: an in-diff docstring/comment makes an absolute or exclusive claim (always/never/all/only/none/no other/every/exactly-N/guarantees) about the behavior of code NOT present in the diff, where nothing in the change substantiates the claim and documenting that out-of-diff contract is the change's stated purpose
must_not_fire: self-scoped or disclaiming docstrings that assert nothing about out-of-diff behavior (the C4 pattern: 'this module does not define how consumers ...')
claims about in-diff code, including claims the change's own hunks substantiate (the m4h-C3 pattern)
PR title/description vs diff scope mismatches with no docstring absolute claim (the C4-row and M4-extra pattern)
claims about external well-known semantics or platform behavior (C13/C2/C16 patterns)
docstring-promises-vs-in-diff-code contradictions (the C12 pattern — that is dsc territory, not m4rel)
candidate.runtime_constraints: no oracle-role, source-record, or record-index branching at runtime; the candidate sees only PR content like any production consumer

authority_separation: this preregistration freezes detection scope and validation material ONLY; a pass does not self-grant preservation authority (QG5/22A)
